title: todo/v1 snapshot
description: Data of a session entry with customType "todo/v1": the whole todo list after a change. See CONTRACT.md. Readers ignore properties they do not know; later v1 releases may add optional properties.

tasks.description: Every task in id order, including deleted tombstones.

nextId.description: Id the next created task receives.

activeForm.description: Present-continuous label shown while the task is in progress.

blockedBy.description: Ids of tasks this task waits on.

owner.description: Who works on the task, e.g. an agent or session name.

metadata.description: Free-form fields. A top-level key is a namespace; an extension that registered it with todo:namespace validates its value before every change.

anchor.description: The check that shows the task is done, e.g. a test command.

evidence.description: Runs of checks, oldest first. Append-only: a later snapshot of the same task starts with the earlier snapshot's entries.

sha.description: Revision the check ran on, e.g. a git commit SHA.

changedEvent.title: todo:changed payload
changedEvent.description: Emitted on pi.events after every change and when a session's list is restored.

readyEvent.title: todo:ready payload
readyEvent.description: Emitted on pi.events when the todo extension loads; namespace owners register again on it.

namespaceEvent.title: todo:namespace payload
namespaceEvent.description: Emitted on pi.events by a namespace owner. Besides v and ns it carries validate(value, task, op) => string | undefined, a function, which JSON Schema cannot describe.
